body.statement: There exist constants \(0<c_0<C_0<\infty\), depending only on \(s,M,v,\alpha\), such that for all sufficiently large \(n\), \[c_0\min\{1,\rho_n/\kappa_n\}\le L_n^{\mathrm{known}}(\kappa_n)\le C_0\min\{1,\rho_n/\kappa_n\}.\]
body.justification: The oracle rate isolates weak-denominator uncertainty from the additional cost of locating the cutoff and is uniform over the observable reduced-form class.
body.gap: NoackRothe2024 proves honest known-cutoff Anderson--Rubin coverage and regular strong-first-stage equivalence, but does not state this triangular-array minimax expected-length order.
body.consumer: The all-regime frontier uses this theorem as its required oracle reduction when the cutoff is supplied or strongly localized.
